desktop.notes:
• Phone crop with touch: the frame stays in the middle; one finger moves the photo under it, pinch zooms; drag a corner or edge to resize - when you let go the view zooms to the new frame. Twist with two fingers or use the straighten dial (it clicks at 0°, tap the angle for 0°). A thirds grid while you touch, a fine grid while you straighten. Shapes follow Portrait / Landscape (4:5 reads 5:4 when turned), the label shows the real size.
• Wording: 30 texts shorter and clearer, on the computer and the phone alike.
